patch_list: Adds an Extensions menu to install and manage uBlock Origin, Violentmonkey, Tampermonkey and Dark Reader, and shows their popups. Add-ons run in private mode, like every Focus tab; their data survives Erase. Installed add-ons are checked f…
Disables the usage ping and experiments.
Forces a family-safe DNS filter and locks the browser's Secure DNS setting.
Hides the search widget promo and tip bubbles.
Move address bar to the bottom
Moves the address bar (browser toolbar) from the top to the bottom of the screen.
